title: An ally calls you to war
story: A messenger from {neighbor} comes to the Bahay ng Datu. {datu}'s alliance is at war with {enemy}, and {datu} asks you to stand with them.

choices.label: Stand with {datu}
choices.result: You send word that {neighbor} does not fight alone. {datu} is grateful; {enemy} will remember.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: You keep your warriors home. {datu} says little, but the messenger leaves cold.

sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
